description: Write/Edit/NotebookEdit calls that reach this point already passed the 00-hard-deny path-escape check — i.e. they're inside the worktree, scratch dir, or allowed .git area. Freely allowed: writing code is the whole point of the implementation agent.

Any Bash segment not resolved by an earlier rule — surfaced to the human via canUseTool rather than silently allowed or blocked. `{kind: 'all', of: []}` is vacuously true (matches every segment), so this is the true catch-all.
